verdict.rationale: Agent-oriented documentation such as llms.txt is a fair question for a SaaS analytics product with public docs and APIs, so the axis applies. However, probes found llms.txt, docs.md and OpenAPI specs all returning 404, and no evidence of agent-oriented docs exists. The Stats and Events API docs are ordinary human-facing developer documentation and are not agent-oriented docs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
